findings.title: Removing the task-N title rule makes titles unreachable or mis-resolved
findings.why: `find` in src/domain/list.ts:58-62 looks up ids before titles. If a task titled `task-2` exists and a later task is issued id `task-2`, every title-based operation (`find`, `complete`, `reopen`, `rename`, `tag`, `untag`, `remove`) on `task-2` acts on the id-matching task. The task titled `task-2` can then only be reached by its own id. The removed rule prevented this, so the claim that it 'added no safety' is wrong. `add` also never checks that a new title is distinct from existing ids.

findings.title: Replacement test does not check the case that breaks
findings.why: The test adds a task titled `task-2`, then checks only that `find(a.id)` returns `A`. It never checks that the task titled `task-2` can still be reached by that title. The title and id collision is therefore untested, and the test would pass even though that task is unreachable by title.
